about.title: About Us
about.heroSub: Your data, your secrets — protected by AES-256-GCM encryption
about.heroDesc: A secure digital vault born from a simple idea: to give everyone a safe place for their most important files, passwords, notes, and media — all encrypted locally on your device.
about.visionDesc: To be the most trusted Arabic digital vault — combining security, ease of use, and innovation in one seamless experience, accessible anytime, anywhere.
about.missionDesc: We make digital security accessible to everyone through an intuitive platform that protects your data with the strongest encryption standards, without compromising on user experience.
about.valuesDesc: Precision in security, transparency in privacy, excellence in execution, and commitment to providing the best for our users.
about.whyDesc: Not because we are the biggest — but because we protect what matters most. Every feature is built with security and privacy in mind.
about.feature1Desc: AES-256-GCM encryption ensures your data is protected by the same standards used by banks and governments worldwide.
about.feature2Desc: Files, photos, notes, passwords — all organized in one secure place with smart categorization and instant search.
about.feature3Desc: Your data never leaves your device. Everything is encrypted and decrypted locally — we have no access to your information.
about.timelineDesc: From idea to launch — a continuous journey of development and improvement.
about.m1Detail: Khaznati was born from the urgent need for a secure Arabic digital vault that protects sensitive data with the highest encryption standards.
about.m2Detail: The first version was launched with core vault features: file encryption, note storage, and password management using AES-256-GCM.
about.m3Detail: Added multi-vault support, fingerprint and face recognition, brute force protection, and the activity log system.
about.m4Detail: The current version — a complete digital vault with file manager, media gallery, encrypted notes, password manager, and an intuitive user interface.
about.founderDesc: From idea to platform — a passion for technology and security.
about.founderRole: Systems Analyst & Planner — Full-Stack Developer — Founder of Khaznati & Dalylak
about.founderBio: A systems engineer with over 10 years of experience in systems analysis and digital solutions development. He believes that security, knowledge, and creativity should be accessible to every young Arab with a single touch. That's why he built Khaznati — a platform that protects your digital life with the highest security standards.
about.contactDesc: We constantly strive to improve Khaznati. If you have a suggestion or found a bug, don't hesitate to reach out.
